shipped_rows.title_o: Dose–effect relations in time-limited psychotherapy for depression.
shipped_rows.authors_o: Barkham; Rees; Stiles; Shapiro; Hardy; Reynolds

blind_target.evidence_quote: The current study sought to replicate the GEL model and explore if session frequency moderates the influence that the number of sessions has on the rate of change in psychotherapy.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The abstract reports consistency with the GEL model, but neither identifies a particular published target nor states the finding of any specific original. Agreement with a model alone does not establish a target-specific outcome.

luna_triage.reason: The abstract states a replication of the general-enough level (GEL) model, but does not identify a specific published empirical original or its finding. The supplied shipped original is a psychotherapy dose-effect paper, but the abstract alone does not establish that it is the model source retested. Need full Results/Discussion and references to identify the specific original finding and distinguish it from the measure citation.

quality_gate: Luna is triage only. Independently establish actual empirical retesting and absence under ALL shipped identities/alternate reports. Read prior objections. No paper outcome is being requested.
